name: EasySecure Data Import/Export for WooCommerce
author: imminentsoftwares

sections.description:
EasySecure Data Import/Export for WooCommerce allows store owners to import and export:

  • Orders
  • Customers
  • Subscriptions

Features:

  • CSV Import
  • CSV Export
  • XLSX Import
  • XLSX Export
  • Background Job Processing
  • Batch Processing
  • WooCommerce Compatible
  • Secure File Handling
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/easysecure-data-import-export-for-woocommerce directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to the plugin settings page to begin importing or exporting data.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Which file formats are supported?

CSV and XLSX.

short_description: Import and export WooCommerce Orders, Customers and Subscriptions using CSV and XLSX files with background job processing.
